title: BHB - Black Hole Boom: Kerr equatorial collision and hypothetical photon transport R2

model.spacetime: stationary uncharged Kerr, equatorial plane, signed a/M in [-1,1]
model.units: geometrized G=M=c=1, radii r/M, conserved specific energy E and angular momentum Lz/M, rest energies GeV
model.region: strictly exterior to r_+/M=1+sqrt(1-a^2); no collision exactly on horizon
model.collision_invariant: E_cm^2=m1^2+m2^2-2*m1*m2*g(u1,u2), independently evaluated in local ZAMO tetrad and Kerr coordinate metric
model.infinity_infall_access: E>=1, future-directed, inward, with strictly positive global minimum of R/r for all r>=r_event; rejects exterior barriers and asymptotic double-root separatrices
model.hypothetical_photon: separately chosen outward equatorial null ray with ZAMO local azimuthal sine s; not tied to collision-product four-momentum
model.photon_escape_condition: positive E_infinity and positive global minimum over [r_emit,infinity) of R_null/r=r^3+(a^2-b^2)*r+2*(b-a)^2, with b=Lz/E_infinity
model.photon_transport_limit: specific equatorial geodesic in stationary Kerr only, not a full emission cone or global radiative-transfer model

claim_ceiling: Large local E_cm and independently escaping hypothetical null rays do not establish photon production, collision luminosity, a black-hole explosion or detection; massive particles remain strictly subluminal in any physical local frame.
limitations: No collision cross sections, final-state four-momentum, scattering, particle production or energy budget.
No photon escape probability over full sky, no out-of-plane Carter constant and no propagation through plasma/accretion disks.
No radiation flux, black-hole mass distribution, spin evolution, backreaction, gravitational-wave instrument response or observational input.
The extremal a/M=1 BSW result is an exterior limiting idealization; no event at the horizon is asserted and astrophysical practical limitations remain.
Outgoing local geodesics may exist kinematically without a verified producer; in that case provenance fails independently of E_cm.

primary_references.role: photon escape probabilities and energy shifts for Kerr zero-angular-momentum sources

next_gate: BHB-R3: specify conservation-compatible collision-product four-momenta and emitter rest frame; propagate resulting null geodesics with Carter constant and compute observable energy distributions under explicit production priors, while preserving all R0-R2 negative controls.
